parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $119.9 million for the quarter, up $16.9 million, or up 16.4%, from the same period in 2024, driven by both acquisition contribution and organic growth .

parsed.notes: The reconciliation table (in thousands) is cut off before the Adjusted EBITDA row, so the figure comes from the narrative text. The Q3 2024 figure is not printed; it would be about $103.0 million (119.9 - 16.9), but it is not reported here. Nine-month Adjusted EBITDA figures are also not shown. FY2025 guidance of $415M-$425M is a forecast, not a reported result, so it is excluded.
